rules.accepted_boundary: an acknowledged accepted version is immutable and later local messages are held
rules.case_identity: case_id, sender_case_id, patient_key, and suspect_product_key must all match
rules.delivery_identity: first occurrence of a message_id wins; later deliveries are duplicates
rules.event_order: process accepted messages by source_sequence, then message_id
rules.execution: local review staging only; no regulatory transmission or acknowledgement is executed
rules.nullification: requires a non-empty nullification_reason and exact identity
rules.pending_boundary: do not change a case while its durable submission acknowledgement is pending
rules.queue: accepted serious cases stage to expedited_review; accepted non-serious cases stage to routine_review
rules.version_chain: new versions must be contiguous from the durable current version
